name: Citrus Village Shopping Center
demographics: Citrus Village Shopping Center serves the Redlands community and surrounding Inland Empire area, attracting primarily middle to upper-middle income families and professionals. The trade area draws from established residential neighborhoods with a mix of young families, working professionals, and retirees typical of the Redlands demographic profile. Shoppers tend to be convenience-focused, seeking everyday retail and services within a comfortable, accessible open-air environment that caters to regular weekly shopping needs rather than destination shopping trips.
description: Citrus Village Shopping Center is a well-established community retail destination located on East Redlands Boulevard in Redlands, California. This open-air shopping center serves as a convenient hub for the local community, offering a practical mix of retail stores and services that cater to everyday shopping needs. With operating hours from 7:00 AM to 11:00 PM, the center provides extended accessibility for busy shoppers throughout the day. The property has earned a solid reputation among local residents, reflected in its 4.3-star rating from nearly 950 Google reviews, demonstrating consistent community engagement and satisfaction. Managed by CBM1, a Southern California-based commercial real estate firm specializing in retail properties, Citrus Village Shopping Center represents the type of neighborhood-oriented retail environment that has become essential to suburban communities in the Inland Empire region.
summary: Citrus Village Shopping Center is a community-focused retail destination on East Redlands Boulevard, serving the Redlands area with convenient shopping and services. With a 4.3-star rating from nearly 950 reviews and extended daily hours, it has established itself as a reliable neighborhood shopping hub.
